status_semantics.implemented_partial: native code and deterministic wire-shaped evidence exist; the capability group still lacks one or more required lifecycle or platform proofs
status_semantics.blocked_unsupported: adapter rejects before transport until an approved endpoint fixture exists
status_semantics.verified: the listed narrow capability evidence has a fixture, exact request/response or Fabric result, and the required lifecycle assertion

evidence.request: fixture Telegram update is parsed into a Fabric ingress envelope
evidence.response: chat/sender/thread/reply/message identity is preserved

evidence.request: DM and gated-group updates with reply-to-bot, exact mention, command, and ordinary-message shapes
evidence.response: only DM/reply/mention/command updates reach Fabric; mention is removed and ordinary group traffic has no media request
evidence.missing: [evidence_boundary] Local policy and admission-before-media wire is complete. [external_gap] Live Telegram group permissions, actual account mention behavior, C6 listener/supervisor assembly, and production identity changes remain unverified.
